name: restart-preserves-record
setup: write an opaque public/secret pair, restart the storage app, then get it
assertions: the exact opaque pair records are returned

name: malformed-record-is-reported
setup: place invalid JSON or an invalid pair envelope in the local-file store
assertions: the provider returns a safe provider outcome
file paths and raw contents are not exposed

name: provider-failure-does-not-leak
setup: deny file access or make the provider unavailable
assertions: no record body is included in the error

name: invalid-bootstrap
setup: remove storage-root or its write permission
assertions: activation fails before accepting storage calls
the failure does not expose record contents
